title: pinMode, digitalRead, and digitalWrite

spans.text: Set a pin's direction with `pinMode`. `digitalRead` returns `HIGH` or `LOW`; `digitalWrite` sets an output level. `INPUT_PULLUP` enables a weak internal resistor, so a button between D2 and GND reads `LOW` when pressed.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: UNO commonly uses 5 V logic; ESP32 uses 3.3 V. Respect GPIO current limits and never connect an LED without a resistor.
